title: MKM-Orchestrator bounded automation task queue v1
description: Machine-first execution SSOT for bounded automation. Not parsed from CENTRAL_AGENT_MEMORY_V1.md. Human narrative stays in central memory; sync one-line outcomes only. Pair with per-task timeout_seconds and audit append (e.g. reports/mkm_orchestrator_audit.jsonl).

workspace_root_hint.description: Optional host path for operators; orchestrator should resolve via MKM_WORKSPACE_ROOT or cwd.

notes.description: Human-only reminder; orchestrator must ignore for execution.

task_id.description: Stable id (UUID or slug). Used for idempotent approval and audit.

track_tag.description: Governance tag: B-track tasks must not auto-promote to A-track/live.

runtime_class.description: Execution weight class for polling split. quick=high-frequency, heavy=low-frequency.

cadence_seconds.description: Optional recurring cadence. On merge-existing injection, done tasks can be re-armed to pending when due.

sensitivity_level.description: high => HITL gate before run; maps to Telegram approval when orchestrator enabled.

kind.description: powershell => powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File path_rel; python => py path_rel; cursor_cli => cursor agent <args>

path_rel.description: Repo-relative path from workspace root (forward slashes ok).

args.description: Trailing CLI args only; workspace injected by caller.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-task ceiling; do not use a global 5m default for all kinds.

heartbeat_file_rel.description: Optional path rel; runner touches this file periodically for stall detection.

use_cursor_cli_auto.description: If true and task runtime_class is heavy, poller may route this task through Cursor CLI automatically.

cursor_cli_args.description: Arguments passed after `cursor agent` when cursor_cli auto-route is enabled.

cursor_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for cursor_cli execution when auto-route is used.

required.description: If true and unresolved, orchestrator must not start runner.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for Telegram GO; duplicate approvals no-op.

log_snippet.description: Optional short stderr/stdout tail pointer; avoid secrets.
